name: spatial_apply_style_dials
description: Configures parametric aesthetic style dials (clutter density, jitter angle, snap grid) for a zone or room.

clutter_density.description: Normalized clutter density factor (0.0 = sterile to 1.0 = heavy clutter)

rotation_jitter_deg.description: Random yaw rotational jitter angle in degrees (e.g. 0 = strict grid, 25 = natural disarray)
